_note: Titles of the clubs of the Pro A, shown as a small mention on the team page. Years are the END of the season as Wikipedia writes them (2026 = 2025-26). Gathered on 2026-11-17 from the pages named in `sources`, which warn that their own sourcing is thin: to be checked against the federation's records before they are treated as official. `league` = Championnat de Tunisie (men), `cup` = Coupe de Tunisie (men), `africa` = FIBA Africa Basketball League / Champions Cup winners, `bal` = Basketball Africa League winners. `africa_final` / `bal_final` / `arab_final` / `maghreb_final` = lost the final (runner-up) of the African Champions Cup / the BAL / the Arab Club Basketball Championship / the Maghreb Championship; these are played over a calendar year. Third and fourth places are deliberately not listed. The Maghreb Championship has no published list of editions: only the 2003 title of JS Kairouan could be verified, so a club without an entry there is not found, which is not the same as never. League and Cup list only wins; a club absent from a list has none.
